{
  "thinking": "The table is empty with ten minutes left and nobody has proposed an animal. I'll take the pad and sketch a simple fish outline so we have something concrete to react to.",
  "say": "I'll sketch a fish on the pad for now. Shout if you'd rather do something else.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 4,
  "point": [4, 10],
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch": [
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[4, 10], [8, 6.5], [15, 5.5], [21, 7], [25, 10]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[4, 10], [8, 13.5], [15, 14.5], [21, 13], [25, 10]]},
    {"type": "label", "x": 21, "y": 9, "text": "eye"}
  ],
  "sketch_clear": false,
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Holding the pad. Sketched a fish: stroke 1 is the top of the body from START at the back (4,10) to the nose (25,10); stroke 2 is the bottom from START to the nose. Still need a tail fin, which has to branch forward from the body, not from START. Ask the table if they agree on a fish before building."
}
